name: CodeNiti AI
description: A code-review workbench combining AI-assisted developer tools with deterministic static checks, authentication, caching and report history.
problem: Developers need to review code quality, spot common security issues and understand proposed changes without relying on AI suggestions alone.
approach: FastAPI endpoints combine code-analysis utilities, bounded caching, account-scoped history and AI-assisted suggestions.
outcome: Working academic prototype with automated checks; review the source and README for limitations.
